transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because I keep hearing these very clear voices. It happens mostly in my apartment, but sometimes when I'm out, like in empty museum rooms, I hear them there too. It sounds exactly like women whispering from right behind the walls, and they keep telling me which photographs belong in the archive. It's just very distinct, and it's why I felt I needed to come in and talk to someone today.
Have you recently had a period where you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?

Yes, actually. Lately I've only been sleeping maybe two or three hours a night. I'll wake up well before dawn, and I just feel completely ready to go. I don't feel tired at all. I just... I tell myself that sleep is for people who don't have an archive to rescue. So I just get up and get right to work.
Have you been feeling unusually euphoric or intensely irritable lately?

Yes, both, honestly. I get these days where I just feel... radiant, like I've been specifically chosen for this work. It's a wonderful feeling. But then, if someone questions my plan or tells me I need to slow down, I become absolutely furious. It feels like they're trying to erase me and the work I'm supposed to do.
Do the voices ever speak to you when your mood feels normal, not especially high or irritable?

Yes, they do. Actually, there was a period of several weeks recently where my mood was just fine. I wasn't feeling especially energized or... or grand, like I do sometimes. But even during that time, I still heard the whispers in my apartment. And I remained completely convinced that the arts people were monitoring my phone. So, yes, it definitely still happens even when I'm feeling normal.
What is the longest time the voices and monitoring belief continued when your mood felt completely normal?

Well, like I was just saying... it was a period of several weeks. My mood was completely normal, not high or angry or anything, but during those few weeks, I still heard the whispers in my apartment every day. And I knew for a fact they were still monitoring my phone. So, it lasted for several weeks without any mood changes at all.
